_about: Controls that change state, matched on the element a tap will actually hit.
A rule matches when its `rid` regex full-matches the element's resource-id or anchor
(if given) AND its `label` regex is found in the lowercased text or content-desc (if given).
`action` = a write the operator can enable for a run (--allow-write <action>).
`forbidden` = refused unless the operator allows that rule id for the run (--allow-rule <id>).
App rules (under `apps`, keyed by package) are checked before `any_app` rules. First match wins.
`counted` (per app) = taps that open a read the policy/reads.py hooks should count.
`composers` = boxes where typing is a send (comment, message, reply); text entry there is refused.

composers.hint: ^(add a comment( for .+)?(…|\.\.\.)?|what do you think of this\??|message(…|\.\.\.)?|reply to .*|post your reply|write a (comment|message).*|add a caption.*)$
